rows.requirement: Evidence-native research with claim-to-source, freshness, permission, contradictions, citations and provenance
Analysis lineage, transformation/formula history, exact capability qualification, uncertainty and reproducibility
Scenario assumptions, input sources, model/tool, uncertainty, calibration metadata and non-reality truth labels
Evidence-bound versioned artifact packages with provenance and governed publication intent
Retrieved content remains data; external publication/deployment remains outside FA-14
FA-14 composes with Project/Work/Agent/Artifact/Evidence and does not narrow AXIOM
